Question: How to set up my Xfinity Home Internet gateway?
Actual Answer:
Here’s how to set up and activate your Xfinity Home Internet gateway:

Download and open the Xfinity app
Sign in with your Xfinity ID and password. You’ll need to be the Primary user or a Member on the account. (xfinity.com)

Start activation
In the app, select Get Started. If you’re replacing an existing gateway and don’t see the prompt, go to Account → Set up equipment or devices → Xfinity Gateway or Modem. (xfinity.com)
xfinity.com

Place your gateway
Put it in an open area, a few feet off the floor, and avoid cramped spaces like closets or behind furniture for better WiFi coverage. (xfinity.com)
xfinity.com

Connect the coax cable
Screw one end of the coax cable into the gateway’s Cable In/RF In port and the other end into an active cable wall outlet. Make sure it’s finger-tight. (xfinity.com)

Plug in the power cord
Connect the power adapter to the gateway and plug it into an electrical outlet. The gateway may be ready to activate in about 5 minutes. (xfinity.com)

Wait for the gateway lights
If your gateway has one light, it’s ready when the light turns white, either solid or blinking. If it has multiple lights, it’s ready when the top three lights are solid. (xfinity.com)

Check the connection in the app
Select Check Connection in the Xfinity app. If the outlet isn’t active, try another cable outlet. (xfinity.com)

Name your WiFi and set a password
The app will prompt you to create or confirm your WiFi network name and password. If you’re upgrading or moving service, you may be able to keep your previous settings. (xfinity.com)

Finish setup

Monthly overage limit: Overage charges are capped at $100 per month.
